_comment: Reference snapshot of the wSpec-owned Claude Code settings that CANNOT ship via the wspec plugin (see .claude-plugin/plugin.json) and are still merged into .claude/settings.json by install.ps1/install.sh + wspec/scripts/merge-settings.cjs. mcpServers and hooks come from the plugin itself (.mcp.json, hooks/hooks.json) once it's installed -- they are deliberately NOT in this file. There is no statusLine entry: the plugin's SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks already surface the state banner, and merge-settings.cjs removes a statusLine an earlier version wrote.
_permissions_comment: Read-only wspec MCP tools and read-only git inspection are auto-allowed to cut friction. Mutating tools (setStatus, markTask, archive, postArchive, syncSpec apply:true, appendFindings, recordOverride) and mutating git (commit/push/merge) are deliberately left ungated here so Claude Code's normal per-call prompt still applies. wspec.forgeCaps is read-only. wspec.syncTicket is allowed despite writing to the forge because its content is fully derived from repo state (never free-form model text), it only ever touches a ticket wSpec was already linked to, and it's idempotent (a body_hash match is a no-op). wspec.bindTicket stays gated — it creates tickets and mutates metadata.yaml. wspec.setup stays gated too — it edits settings and git config. Keep this list in step with wspec/mcp/src/lib/settingsMerge.ts and wspec/scripts/merge-settings.cjs.
